metaTitle: Open Source AI: Transparency, Control, and Community
metaDescription: Source-available AI provides transparency, community development, and data control. Learn why GAIA is built as source-available and what it means for your privacy.
definition: Source-available AI refers to artificial intelligence software whose source code is publicly available, allowing anyone to inspect, modify, distribute, and contribute to the project.
extendedDescription: Source-available AI is important for several reasons. Transparency allows users to verify what the software does with their data. Community contribution accelerates development and bug fixing. Self-hosting capability gives users complete data control. Vendor independence prevents lock-in. And open inspection of AI behavior builds trust. In the AI assistant space, source-available is particularly valuable because these systems handle sensitive personal and business data. Users should be able to verify that their emails, calendar events, and communications are handled securely.
howGaiaUsesIt: GAIA is source-available (PolyForm Noncommercial), with the entire codebase available on GitHub. This includes the AI agents, backend API, web frontend, desktop app, mobile app, and all integrations.

faqs.question: Is GAIA really free and source-available?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA's entire codebase is available on GitHub. You can self-host it free for non-commercial use (plus your own model API costs) with full functionality. The hosted version offers convenience with managed infrastructure, but the self-hosted version has full functionality.

faqs.question: Can I contribute to GAIA?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. GAIA welcomes community contributions including new integrations, bug fixes, documentation, and feature development. You can also build and publish custom MCP integrations in the GAIA marketplace.
